Hi Marissa,

We're preparing to ingest Acme's profile into OneTrust and need a short-lived credential flow to stage evidence files and QnA fragments. Scope: ~3k QnA items + ~120 evidence artifacts (pdfs/logs).

Requirements from our side: 1) a mechanism to upload artifacts (SFTP or presigned S3), 2) a mapping file that ties artifacts to QnA ids, 3) brief guidance on retention/TTL for temp creds (we typically use 24–72h).

Can Redwood provide a staging approach and any pre-made mapping template? If presigned URLs, we'll need an upload endpoint and a sample policy. If SFTP, please share host+test creds.

Goal: complete ingest window Aug 10–12.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen

- Mar 2: issue presigned PUTs with 24h TTL (can extend to 72h for bulk windows).
- Mar 3: provide a mapping template (CSV/XLSX) for linking filenames -> QnA ids.

I've attached a short runbook (onetrust_tempcred_instructions.pdf) that describes the process and the roles for the upload window. Ben — can you confirm the commercial/contract callouts (SLA & ingress limits)? Karthik — see infra questions below; I'll need a sample bucket policy and any CIDR restrictions you want enforced.

Hi all — technical notes from infra:

1) We'll provision a dedicated S3 bucket in us-west-2 under the account redwood-onetrust-staging. All objects will be server-side encrypted (AES256) and tagged with "onetrust_inbound" for lifecycle.
2) Presigned PUTs will be generated by a short-lived lambda that issues URLs with configurable TTL. Default: 24h. We can support up to 72h on request for the bulk window.
3) Attached is a sample bucket policy (s3_bucket_policy.txt) that allows PutObject only from our presign lambda principal. If Acme/Onetrust requires direct IP whitelisting, provide CIDR ranges and we can enforce a VPC endpoint.
4) For mapping: filenames must be unique and include the QNA id prefix (example: QA_12345_acme-ssr.pdf). We will validate against the mapping CSV before ingest.

Action items: Acme to confirm CIDR (if any) and whether they prefer 24h or 48h TTL for the Aug 10–12 window. Olivia — can you confirm acceptance so we can provision?

—Karthik
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
